column1: # Fixtures in the ordinary assets/ _ok folders that the pinned Mojo rejects.
# AGENTS.md invariant 1 says this file should be empty; it is the burn-down
# list, and scripts/sweep-assets-mojo fails when reality and this file differ.
# family: alias-keyword (`alias` is still a reserved word at the pin),
# self-qualification (`Self.X` for a struct parameter), unbound-parameter
# (an origin/value parameter the pin makes you bind), missing-import,
# ledgered (an instance of a divergence docs/non-goals.md or the roadmap
# ledger already records), divergence (unclassified acceptance divergence),
# skip (the sweep cannot run it — today only the stdin reader). A family
# with no rows left is one this burn-down has closed.
# The error is the pin's FIRST complaint, so it can mask a later one: lifting
# a mask moves a row to another family rather than deleting it.
